proposed_widenings.name: armed_on_hit_rider
proposed_widenings.justification: The poison coating is armed via a Bonus Action activation (use_count 1, resets at dawn) and then fires a save gate on the *next* weapon hit. No current family expresses this pattern: on_hit_trigger has no arming/activation step; activation family has no on-hit phase kind. A new 'arm then fire on hit' subgraph is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Bonus Action to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw...

proposed_widenings.name: SaveGateRiderResult.damage_and_condition
proposed_widenings.justification: The on-hit save gate's fail branch requires both 2d10 Poison damage AND the Poisoned condition. SaveGateRiderResult is limited to apply_condition | none and cannot express a damage instance. A damage variant (or composite) is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.

notes: The +1 passive (modify_roll_numeric on attack_roll + modify_damage_numeric, both with weaponFilter specific_item) fits cleanly. The poison mechanic has two independent gaps: (1) no 'activation-arms-on-hit-rider' subgraph — the Bonus Action arms a per-hit effect which is conceptually distinct from always-on on_hit_trigger; (2) SaveGateRiderResult is too narrow to express damage alongside a condition on the save fail branch. Both gaps are surface-level (the v4 atom vocabulary has damage, apply_condition, save_gate — the wiring pattern and result variant are what's missing). No content files authored.
